lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters arranged in at least five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a periodic grid-like spatial matrix on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition with high luminance on the upper edge and distinct shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The lateral surface of the first dorsal fin (visible in the upper right) contains a sparse distribution of approximately five high-luminance circular blobs located primarily on the anterior and ventral portions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A white, elongated synthetic tag is attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin. The trailing edge of the left pectoral fin exhibits minor irregular serration or notching.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, irregular high-luminance spots on the cranial and snout regions. Multiple remoras are attached to the ventral surface.
